# Justyna Zurawska — Make It a Choice

> Private strategic thinking and somatic awareness for successful, internationally minded professionals navigating important decisions, transitions and what comes next.

## What this practice helps with
- Career decisions and career transitions
- Leadership decisions and promotions
- Relocation and deciding where to live
- Home and property decisions
- Relationship and life-direction decisions
- Questions about what comes next after achieving an earlier goal

## How the work is different
Justyna Zurawska does not tell clients what to choose. She acts as a thinking partner, helping clients distinguish facts, assumptions and conditioning, emotions and desires, somatic responses, and the trade-offs they are willing to make.

## Method
Strategic thinking + somatic awareness. Work may include coaching conversations, somatic breathwork and practical integration.

## Ways to work together
- Choice Session — a focused session for one important decision
- Private 1:1 Practice — personalised work for a larger transition or period of change
- Somatic Breathwork — individual 90-minute sessions
- The Year Ahead — focused planning for a year with direction and room for spontaneity
- Grief Support and Pretty & Angry — additional practices

## Location
Zurich, Switzerland; work may be offered internationally.
